author: ruggsea
description:
Infini News Corpus v2
	

Release v2 contains 1,372,589,195 extracted articles in 49,748 Parquet files, covering 117 crawl months, August 2016 through April 2026.
The article files occupy 1,667,891,674,639 bytes. Counts come from the accepted release/corpus-summary.json.
This release replaces the earlier extraction. Article offsets belong to one release; use its matching FM-index, metadata store, and row manifest.

	
		
	
	
		Files and row order… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ruggsea/infini-news-corpus.
